item.title: Nail Your Interview with STAR 🌟 • Start with the Situation—set the context. • Define the Task—what needed to be done? • Detail your Actions—what did you do? • End with the Result—what was achieved? • Practice to keep answers concise and focused. How can you apply the STAR method to your next interview question? #interview #careeradvice #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
